pages.title: Truth Mirror
pages.text: Drink from the Truth Mirror to reveal your true self — shed your feral shape and become human once more. $(br)Right-click while transformed to also extract the $(item)soul item$(0) of your current form.

pages.title: The Cleansing Ritual
pages.text: The Spirit Table also accepts a reversal offering: a $(item)water bucket$(0), a $(item)Totem of Undying$(0), an $(item)emerald$(0) and any $(item)boat$(0). Confirm with a Murmol Soul as usual.
